title: Fuel tank range and fueling experience
summary: Feedback on fuel-related topics spans strong range and gas-station convenience comments alongside complaints about difficult fueling and tank-related concerns, with many fragments too descriptive or contextual to show clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise long range per tank or the convenience of avoiding gas stations through plug-in charging.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on fueling problems such as nozzle shutoff or overspill and dissatisfaction with fuel tank capacity for driver needs.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention gas tanks, fuel range, gauges, pressurization, navigation, or prior gas costs without enough context to classify sentiment reliably.

limitations: Several undetermined fragments are descriptive, comparative, or about prior vehicles rather than clearly evaluative of the reviewed vehicle.
This topic mixes distinct subjects including fuel range, gas-station avoidance, fueling mechanics, tank hardware, and navigation prompts, so the cluster is not fully coherent.
